en: You'll need to be very comfortable with databases.
Security: make sure your data is encrypted at rest and during transmission. Make sure to keep your API keys and database password secret.
Data management understand how the data is managed in the Upstream Source system.
DataOps so clearly communicate with stakeholders and set up some sort of observability.

data architecture: understand the Upstream architecture. How do these sources work? How does data flow through these systems? Are there any architectural changes that the Upstream team is going to be making to the data? (schema changes to the data itself.)
Set up data quality checks, data contracts, etc.
